metadata.method: Real execution via serum2/producer/canonical_feedback_loop.py against live Serum2.vst3 through DawDreamer 0.9.0. No mocks. No simulated readbacks.

bugs_found_and_fixed_to_enable_real_exec.bug: diagnose_goal() matched qualified_targets keys directly against goal.semantic_target, but ContractRegistry.get_contracts_dict() returns tuple-keyed (capability_key, sig_hash) -> contract, and capability_key ('envelope_field_release') != semantic_target ('Env1.Release'). This meant execute_producer_from_intent() had never successfully diagnosed against the real registry.
bugs_found_and_fixed_to_enable_real_exec.fix: Bridge goal.semantic_target -> capability_key via SEMANTIC_TARGETS, then match against contract.target (exact match only, no substring/family matching).
bugs_found_and_fixed_to_enable_real_exec.type: genuine wiring bug, not previously exercised end-to-end

bugs_found_and_fixed_to_enable_real_exec.bug: validate_scope_prerequisite() read serum2/knowledge/step_b_evidence_to_capability_integration.json -- a stale legacy design-JSON with no entry for 'envelope_field_release' -- instead of using the already-admitted fresh contract from ContractRegistry. This is exactly the fallback ContractRegistry's own docstring prohibits.
bugs_found_and_fixed_to_enable_real_exec.fix: Replaced the legacy-JSON scope check with scope_info derived directly from the already-admitted contract.scope (single-value authority; no numeric range to check beyond what admission already verified).

bugs_found_and_fixed_to_enable_real_exec.bug: ExecutionRecord dataclass had no 'admission_detail' field, but canonical_feedback_loop.py always passes admission_detail= when constructing episodes -- TypeError on every call, PASS or BLOCKED.
bugs_found_and_fixed_to_enable_real_exec.fix: Added admission_detail: str = "" as the last field (additive, backward-compatible, no reordering of existing positional/default fields).

bugs_found_and_fixed_to_enable_real_exec.bug: execute_producer_feedback_episode() had no way to inject a prerequisite context value (e.g. Decay) before skeleton capture, so the real path could never exercise the BLOCKED prerequisite-mismatch branch or a deliberate PASS with a controlled Decay value.
bugs_found_and_fixed_to_enable_real_exec.fix: Added an optional prerequisite_overrides dict parameter threaded through execute_producer_from_intent -> execute_producer_feedback_episode, applied to body via pathmerge.apply_path_value() before skeleton use -- mirrors the qualification harness's own baseline_overrides mechanism. Real state written into the body Serum actually loads; not a mocked readback.
bugs_found_and_fixed_to_enable_real_exec.type: missing capability, not a defect in existing logic

feedback.note: Episode is in-scope and teaches (positive experience): parameter increase in this verified context produced the predicted metric direction.

PASS.next_decision_input: This PASS episode establishes that, under Decay=0.02 context, Release=1.0 is a validated positive move. A future planner iteration querying episode_retrieval for envelope_field_release + Decay=0.02 context would retrieve this as supporting precedent for repeating the action, not as authority to invent new values (single-value scope still applies).

planning_decision.diagnosis_status: ADVISORY only -- proposed the same capability as PASS; deliberately invalid context applied to test refusal

admission.detail: target 'envelope_field_release' requires prerequisite(s) ['body:Env0.plainParams.kParamDecay'] to be verified in the PROPOSED execution context; caller did not confirm: ['body:Env0.plainParams.kParamDecay']

mutation.note: Execution halted at [3.5/10] Authority admission gate -- code path never reaches the mutation/render block

post_state.note: No mutation occurred; no post-state exists

measurement.note: No render or measurement occurred; both fields are None, not zero or fabricated

feedback.note: Refusal itself is the feedback: Decay=0.3 context is outside this capability's verified scope. A planner encountering this refusal must either re-verify Decay=0.02 before retrying, or treat Release as UNQUALIFIED-in-this-context and seek/request a different capability or new qualification evidence -- it cannot retry the same mutation blindly.

BLOCKED.next_decision_input: Refusal reason 'prerequisite_unverified' with field_path 'body:Env0.plainParams.kParamDecay' is machine-readable enough for a planner to know exactly which live state to re-check before proposing this capability again.

planner_selects_only_admitted_capability.evidence: Both episodes: diagnosis (advisory) names envelope_field_release, but execution is gated entirely on admission_result.admitted at canonical_feedback_loop.py:471(ish). PASS episode: admitted=True, mutation proceeds. BLOCKED episode: admitted=False, mutation never reached (serum_mutation_value=None).

admission_via_real_contractregistry_path.evidence: Both episodes' console trace show '[ContractRegistry] Loaded Release contract: CAUSAL_VERIFIED' / 'Loaded Attack contract: CAUSAL_VERIFIED' before diagnosis begins. contracts_dict passed into admission.admit() originates only from ContractRegistry.get_contracts_dict().

preconditions_verified_against_live_seru.evidence: live_readback_prerequisite() calls harness_mod.resave_state(meta, body, spec=None) -- loads body into a real Serum instance and reads back what Serum actually holds. PASS: readback=0.020000000000000004 (not the declared 0.02 literal -- floating point evidence of a real round-trip through Serum, not a copied value). BLOCKED: readback=0.30000000000000004 (same floating-point evidence).

measurement_not_caller_declared.evidence: render_and_measure() computes measurement_value = METRICS[measurement_metric](audio) where audio is the real rendered waveform from render_arm(). No parameter to render_and_measure or execute_producer_feedback_episode allows a caller to supply a measurement value directly.

producer_cannot_mutate_after_refusal.evidence: BLOCKED episode: serum_mutation_value=null, serum_readback_after=null, audio_treatment=null, measurement_treatment=null. The code path literally returns from inside the 'if not admission_result.admitted' block, before any mutation/render code is reached.

execution_and_verification_reference_sam.evidence: Both episodes: diagnosis.selected_target = contract.target = 'envelope_field_release' used consistently for: admission.admit(target=...), candidate_generation_from_contract(contract), mutation_target_path (from contract.scope), and episode.semantic_target. No point in the trace substitutes a different identity.

planner_cannot_consume_qualified_but_not.evidence: envelope_field_release IS qualified (CAUSAL_VERIFIED) in both episodes -- diagnosis freely names it as a candidate in both. But in the BLOCKED episode, admission (not qualification) is what gates execution, and it refused. This is the exact QUALIFIED-but-NOT-ADMITTED-in-this-context distinction the architecture is designed to enforce: qualification is necessary but not sufficient.

code_changes_made: serum2/producer/diagnosis.py -- diagnose_goal() bridges semantic_target to capability_key via SEMANTIC_TARGETS before matching contracts (real bug fix)
serum2/producer/canonical_feedback_loop.py -- added prerequisite_overrides parameter; replaced legacy-JSON scope check with admitted-contract-derived scope_info
serum2/qualification/vertical_slice_executor.py -- added admission_detail field to ExecutionRecord (additive, default-valued)
note_on_scope_of_changes: All three fixes were required to make the ALREADY-BUILT real execution path actually run; none introduce new architecture, new abstractions, or bypass the admission/evidence discipline. No frozen inventory, no admission.py logic (STEP 4.2's already-verified gate), and no CapabilityContract data were touched.
